PostToolUse.linux:
python3 -c "
import json, sys
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
tool = data.get('tool', '')
if tool not in ('replace_string_in_file', 'multi_replace_string_in_file', 'create_file'):
    sys.exit(0)
input_ = data.get('toolInput', {})
file_path = input_.get('filePath', '') or ''
if (file_path.startswith('core/') or file_path.startswith('api/')) and file_path.endswith('.py'):
    print(json.dumps({'systemMessage': '✅ Backend file edited. Remember to run tests before finishing:\ndocker compose run --rm app python -m pytest tests/ -v\nOr locally: .venv-test/bin/python -m pytest tests/ -x -q'}))
"
